insights.one_liner: Entrust is a US identity and cybersecurity company with about 3,000 staff and a recognised-sponsor Dutch entity, hiring a data role in Haarlem.

culture.text: Entrust builds identity-focused security: verifying identities, securing connections, fighting fraud and protecting keys and certificates for customers in 150+ countries.
Staff mostly studied computer science, engineering or business and work in engineering, IT and sales; 3,737 people are on LinkedIn.

open.text: Entrust Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Entrust had about 3,000 employees in 2025 and revenue of US$916.7 million in 2024.
It expanded its Cryptographic Security Platform with new tools for acting on cryptographic inventory data.

worth_knowing.text: Entrust received Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Global Digital ID Enabling Technology Leadership Recognition.
It is owned by Datacard Group.
